It began when 71-year-old Brazilian fisherman Joao found an oil-covered penguin on a Rio de Janeiro beach, close to death.
The kindhearted fisherman knew that he could not simply walk away from the poor penguin.
He started taking care of the poor penguin and fed it with fish to recover the energy it had lost.
Right after Dindim was able to recover, Joao attempted to release the penguin back into the sea.
If you are thinking that their one-of-a-kind friendship ended there, then you are in for a big surprise!
Apparently, Dindim was so touched by the local fisherman’s kind gesture that it cannot forget about him and considered where he lives as its second home.
In fact, for the past four years, Dindim has already spent 8 months of the year with the kindhearted fisherman in its second home.
According to Professor Krajweski, the one who interviewed Joao for Globo TV, Dindim was the first ever penguin that he had encountered to be sweet, thoughtful, and attached to its rescuer.
Meanwhile, this heartwarming story of a unique friendship has made its way to the big screen.
